messages.subject: guide for count data?
parts:
The Y variable in my data consists of counts that I have taken. I
want to make a stacked bar graph, but so far have not be successful.
Is there a way to tell ggplot that we are starting with count data?
If I have to create an entry for each observation it would drastically
inflate my dataset to an unmanageable size.

Are there any good tutorials, am I missing something?

thanks

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: guide for count data?
parts:
Hi Zev,
I don't think your question is clear. You can make a stacked bar graph
using geom_bar(position = "stacked"). I'm not sure what special
considerations you think are necessary because your data represents
counts, but if you provide a reproducible example we can help you work
though any problems you are having.

Best,
Ista
